headlines.name: COP31 collapse highlights Africa's climate finance woes
headlines.headline: COP31 collapse highlights Africa's climate finance woes
headlines.description: The deep divisions between nations over climate finance, which contributed to the breakdown of COP31 talks, underscored the funding challenges facing African countries as they try to adapt to a warming planet. Although the continent contributes only 4% of global emissions , nine of the 10 most climate-vulnerable countries are in Africa , according to one study.

headlines.name: He expected a small-business loan. He got a 7-year nightmare
headlines.headline: He expected a small-business loan. He got a 7-year nightmare
headlines.description: GLENDALE, Calif. — Sitting at his desk, tucked into a corner of his teenage bedroom — a place where he’d never intended to return, well into middle age — Vahe Shahinian rereads the emails that split his life into before and after. A broker was offering to fund Shahinian’s small business with a line of credit worth $750,000.
